text:
maya: quick heads-up — bringing up q6b-int4 canary on staging. perf looks good but we have a small quality regression on longform recall vs q6b-fp16. need to stitch a mini-golden and run a small relabel + dedupe pass before we push to dedicated :eyes:
sam: can you paste the deltas you saw?
maya: sure — ran 500 canary prompts (multiturn longform). summary:
```
metric             fp16   int4   delta
------------------------------------------------
long_recall@20     0.812  0.773  -0.039
rougeL             0.421  0.409  -0.012
latency(ms)        220    160    -60
cost/tok           1.0    0.46   -54%
```
maya: looks like we trade notable recall for cost/latency wins on >2k token contexts. i'm worried about app-level regressions on our summarization benchmark.
nina: ok — this is curation/labeling work. we should: 1) build mini-golden of ~200 long-context prompts that are sensitive to recall 2) run dedupe (paraphrase + fingerprint) 3) send to labelers for 3-way golden consensus. i can scope labeling capacity.
sam: agree. also suspect kvcache truncation/quantization rounding on repeated entities. can we add a focused sample that checks entity persistence?
maya: yes — add ~60 entity-persistence probes to the mini-golden. include some synthetic paraphrases to trigger edgecases.
labeler-bot: created task ML-GOLD-172468 for "q6b-int4 mini-golden relabel". 260 items assigned to curation-pool. ETA 48h. :robot_face:
nina: capacity note — we have 12 labelers available this week, can do 260 items with 3-way at ~36h. if anyone needs faster, we can reduce to 150 items but risk lower coverage.
devops: FYI — staging cluster autoscaler is set to allow burst for the canary job. if you expect >2x current load ping me.
maya: i'll pare the canary to 250 requests over 3h window for next run. canary config: `--seq-len 4096 --batching auto --prefix-cache on --quant int4`
sam: for dedupe — use both fuzzyhash and embed-sim with threshold 0.86, then manual triage for collisions. add the dedupe script we used last quarter: `scripts/dedupe_paraphrase_v2.sh`
nina: noted. label instructions: focus on content recall first, fluency secondary. use existing golden rubric (link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/curation/golden-rubric). also tag samples with `ENTITY_FLIP` if entities disappear between turns.
maya: i'll kick the dedupe now and post the results.
labeler-bot: dedupe run started (job 172468-dedupe). estimated collisions: ~18%. progress updates in thread.
sam: after relabel, run a quick eval harness: `eval/harness/compare_models.py --models q6b-fp16,q6b-int4 --subset mini-golden` and post the regression diff.
maya: will do. target: no >3% drop in long_recall@20 on the golden after relabeling + prompt tweaks.
nina: assigning reviewers: maya (owner), sam (metric reviewer), rachel (QA) — rachel heads up?
maya: thanks — rachel added. i'll post intermediate numbers and a short canary checklist in this thread.
labeler-bot: relabel complete. 260 -> consensus achieved on 244 items (16 abstains). uploading labels to s3: s3://redwood-qa/q6b-int4-mini-golden/172468/results.json
maya: running eval now...
maya: first pass after relabel + two prompt tweaks: long_recall@20 = 0.793 (delta -0.019 vs fp16). still slightly below target but much improved. latency/cost unchanged.
sam: that's promising. can we try one more prompt scaffold change (explicit retention hint) across 40 probes and re-eval? might close the gap without model change.
nina: we have labeling slack for those 40 extra examples — can be done in 6 hours.
maya: ok doing scaffold A on 40 probes. will re-run harness after labels land.
labeler-bot: added 40 quick probes to ML-GOLD-172468-extra. 12 labelers assigned. ETA 6h.
maya: final — with scaffold A applied, long_recall@20 = 0.806 (delta -0.006). under threshold. recommend we proceed to limited dedicated canary with rollout gating and monitoring dashboards for recall and entity flip rate.
sam: +1 from metrics. set canary gate to hold if entity_flip_rate > 1.5% or long_recall drop > 1%.
nina: I'll update the golden registry and tag this run `q6b-int4-mini-golden-20241231` and link the consensus set.
maya: filing rollout ticket and will schedule a post-mortem if anything drifts. thanks team :tada:
